title: 真题演练 · 倒装句
hint: 本组题目按本单元语法点与词池生成/匹配;答错后点击「回溯语法课」复习 倒装句。

questions.analysis: 否定词放句首,助动词提前:Never have I eaten。

questions.q: Only when he returned ___ the truth.
questions.analysis: Only + 从句放句首,主句倒装:did he know。

questions.q: He is a teacher, and ___ his wife.
questions.analysis: so + be 动词 + 主语,表"也"。

questions.q: Hardly ___ the airport when the plane took off.
questions.analysis: Hardly...when 句型,主句倒装用过去完成时。

questions.q: Not only ___ the exam, but he also got full marks.
questions.analysis: not only 放句首,前半句部分倒装。

questions.q: 判断对错:Never I have seen such a movie.
questions.analysis: 应改为:Never have I seen such a movie.。否定词放句首必须部分倒装,助动词提前。
